description.value: Steve's Poké Bar is an authentic Hawaiian poké chain founded in Vancouver by Steve Huynh, who grew up between Vancouver and Honolulu perfecting family poké recipes. Voted the #1 Best Poké in Vancouver and boasting over 10,000 five-star Google reviews, the restaurant distinguishes itself by marinating fish the traditional Hawaiian way rather than offering fusion-style bowls. It has grown to multiple locations across the Lower Mainland, making it a recognizable quick-service stop for cyclists passing through the area.
